voice.summary: Greenlit talks like a helpful analyst who has a good answer ready. It is upbeat, plain and quick, and promises quick insight rather than deep magic.
dos: Lead with what the user will get
donts: Do not use technical jargon in the hero

taglines: Insights as soon as you upload
Work smarter with your own numbers
From file to finding in seconds
boilerplate: Greenlit is a data tool that turns uploaded information into clear insights right away, with voice and prompt input.

microcopy.success: File uploaded. Ask your first question.
microcopy.error: We could not read that file. Try a CSV or spreadsheet.
microcopy.empty: No data yet. Attach a file to begin.

logo.note: A cloud suggests uploading your data into something useful.
